title: Contract for clearing a work tape
statement: For a $k$-tape machine, a tape index $i$, and an input word $x$, consider the clearing machine that sweeps right over the stored word and then rewinds while erasing it. For each word $w$ and eligible starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state, require that tape $i$ contains the buffer encoding of $w$ at every offset $p$ from $-1$ through $|w|$. The machine finishes after exactly $2|w|+2$ steps in the done state; it clears tape $i$ on the cells from the starting head position through the cell immediately before that position plus $|w|$, leaves other tapes unchanged, and all work-head positions stay within the stated envelope: on tape $i$ from one cell left of the starting position through the starting position plus $|w|$, and on every other tape at its starting position.
